name_input: RINGSPANN POWER TRANSMISSION INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (slug: ringspann-power-transmission-india-private-limited) shows 3,256 total shipment records, latest cargo 2026-02-26. One outbound row is explicitly visible: date 2026-02-23, supplier 'RINGSPANN POWER TRANSMISSION INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED', buyer 'FIRMA', goods 'Cone Clamping Element RLK 300 40 x 45, Customer material no. 4203-040001-000000', origin 'SAHAR AIR CARGO ACC INBOM4, India', destination 'FRANKFURTMAIN INTL, GERMANY', HS 84312090, BOL 9931315. Source counter: page states 'Total Shipments 3256 Records detected'; rows actually rendered on the free view = 5 (4 inbound + 1 outbound). Only 1 export row was visible, so the export share of the 3,256 is not determinable from the free view.
domestic_evidence: No domestic supply evidence could be retrieved. GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender participation and annual-report India sales splits were not accessible: thecompanycheck.com, zaubacorp.com and eximpedia.app all returned HTTP 403, and web_search was unavailable (searx connection refused) for the whole session. ImportKey's 'Buyers' block lists Indian counterparties (e.g. 'CAPARO ENGINEERING INDIA LIMITED, RINGSPANN POWER TRANSMISSION INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED, LECHLER INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED, UNO MINDA LIMITED') but that block is a co-occurrence list of firms sharing a trade lane, not a domestic supply record, so it is not counted as evidence. Domestic status left as unknown, not asserted.
note: Export side is factually confirmed: a dated outbound customs record with destination Germany, HS 84312090 and BOL 9931315 exists, so this is not a website claim. Note the declared HS 843120 (forklift/truck parts) matches the observed export line 84312090, but the company's actual trade is dominated by freewheels, cone clamping elements and couplings under HS 84836090 and 73182910 — the 843120 code appears on only one of the visible lines, so the HS classification should be treated as narrow rather than representative. The bulk of the 3,256 records visible are INBOUND (Ringspann GmbH Germany, Ringspann Tianjin China, Ringspann Italia, Woo Chang Korea supplying the Indian entity), i.e. the Indian company is primarily an importer/distributor-manufacturer of the German group, with export activity confirmed but of unquantified volume. Revenue and export value: null — no public figure obtained, not estimated. Domestic supply traces: not found in accessible sources; this is a gap in verification, not proof of absence.
